title: Proof of Barry's Four Hankel Determinant Conjectures
summary: Barry introduced a central transform of integer sequences and proposed four conjectures concerning the Hankel transforms of central transform of four rational families. We prove these four conjectures. The proofs are unified within a common algebraic framework: we interpret the Hankel determinants as Gram determinants and use a basis of shifted monic Chebyshev polynomials to reveal the finite-band structure of the associated Gram matrices.
